name: Burger Queen Set
description:
OM NOM NOM. Need a new job? Are you thirsty at all? Or are you just HUNNgry?



Enjoy the Burger Queen Item Set for your Dollys, dreamt up by [SunnyDayz](https://buy.hunnys.io/portfolio/0x48a19c6B158491325E84c8837ED8Ba95A0403C13) of Hupe Scout & Rainbow Mallow Beaches fame!



Owning this unlocks the following set of Hunnys Closet items:

Hair Style: BQ Server Pony

Hand: BQ Soda

Hand: BQ Large Fries

Hand: BQ Carrot Patty Burger

Hat: BQ Visor

Outfit: BQ Apron



All pieces purchased within this Hunnys Closet Shop collection will immediately unlock the specified item(s) for use in the [Hunnys Closet](https://closet.hunnys.io).



As long as you currently hold this token in the same wallet that you are connected with when using the Hunnys Closet, it will automatically be available for use - enjoy!
